notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.4.0 is out! Here are the changes: 

Added a new side story, "Eureka!"

Added an achievement for completing the new side story.

Redesigned the main menu and the notification UI.

Improved character visibility in free roam during dark weather.

Fixed an issue where sprites could "stick" on the screen in certain cases.

Fixed an issue with sound effects spilling out from the snowball minigame.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1: The Optimization Update
notes.notes:
Patch 1.3.1 is out! Here are the changes:

Massively improved performance across the board.

The effects of this vary based on specs and in-game location, but in general, the game should be much less resource intensive. We’ve been seeing roughly doubled frame rates on our machines.

For greatest effect, consider turning on the "LOD in low-density scenes" setting.

Adjusted the difficulty of Monkey Zong.

Barrels roll slower and spawn in more predictable spots.

Player movement and level design have been slightly altered.

Added a target frame rate setting (VSync must be off to access this!)

Added a setting to see your in-game FPS.

Added a setting to run the game in the background.

Added the ability to open the map with ‘M’ during free roam.

Adjusted the credits to include new team members and up-to-date expansion information.

Overhauled the lighting for the school hallway scene.

Improved environmental lighting during cloudy and stormy weather.

We know a lot of these features have been highly requested, so we're looking forward to hearing your thoughts! Additionally, we will have a content update, including a new side story, in the near future.

- Lyko Studio

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.3.0 is out! Here are the changes:

Added a new side story, “Amelia Directs a Movie!”

Added a new Steam achievement and in-game sticker for completing the new side story

Fixed an issue where characters would appear in the pause menu before you met them

Adjusted some dialogue across Weeks 2 and 3

Adjusted some lines in Viola and Yonaka’s side stories

Adjusted the thumbnail for the “A Drawing of You” side story

Here’s the Amelia-focused side story, as promised in the Character Bracket Competition a couple months ago! Some other favorites from the bracket, like Britney, Akari, and Viola, may also be involved 👀

This one has multiple endings, and you need the best ending in order to get the achievement, so good luck!

- Lyko Studio

Adjusted the volume of the programming minigame’s music and sound effects

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1.1 is out! Here are the changes:

Steam achievements are now unlockable as you get their associated sticker, not just on game launch
Added the achievement for completing Amelia's character story to Steam
Fixed a bug preventing players from returning to the title at the end of the game
Made the character friendship stat more visible in the character menu

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.0 is out! Here are the changes:

 An extras menu, featuring:

 A new side story
 A way to access all character stories you’ve done before
 A way to access all stickers across all save files
 Steam achievement integration, based on stickers
 Improved menu UI, including:

 A more phone-like look
 The ability to give your save files descriptions
 A save button next to the menu button during regular dialogue
 A sticker menu that’s much easier to use

We hope you enjoy the new side story and UI! New side content will continue to show up in future updates, so please stay tuned.

- Lyko Studio

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is out!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.3 is out! Here are the changes:

 Updated power outage graphics, making them reflect when the power is out in Week 4.
 Fixed various typos and grammatical errors.
 Added character-specific narration boxes.
  Clarified dialogue where characters besides Neku speak while not on screen.
 Adjusted the history UI to use non-Neku names when appropriate. 

We noticed people referencing a specific scene where Neku appears to say Chloe's dialogue. This has been patched, as well as some similar occurrences at other points in the game. Thanks to everyone who  brought this to our attention; we appreciate the speculation!

- Lyko Studio

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is Out!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.2 is out! Here are the changes:

Patched the primary issue causing crashes (details below).
Corrupted save files are now detected in the load screen.
Corrupted save files no longer prevent other save files from showing up in the load screen.
Fixed a minor issue related to Emi's story event.

After two months of investigation, we found the source of the persistent crashing many people have been reporting! There's an issue with Unity's Visual Scripting package, where data will slowly build up in the stack as you progress from node to node, without ever being freed. This meant that, especially on Windows machines with a smaller stack size, crashes could happen as often as once a week.

We implemented a system that manually frees said stack data every time a new day starts, so it's extremely unlikely enough data will build up to cause a crash. We found internally that this fixed all instances of the issue, but if you continue to experience problems, please let us know!

Thank you all so much for your patience, and apologies for those of you who were affected! This issue was just as frustrating for us as we imagine it was for you.

- Lyko Studio

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.1 is out! Here are the changes:

 Added support for ultrawide displays.
 Added support for windowed mode (via a checkbox in the settings menu).
 Added automatic resolution changes if the current one isn’t supported by the display.
 Made minor audio/visual improvements in the park, town, cabin, and arcade locations.
 Removed a way to go out of bounds in the town location.
 Fixed some instances of the wrong character being displayed during a line of dialogue.
 Fixed a floor-clipping issue that took place after Yonaka’s story events.
 Fixed an issue which allowed for fast travel at certain unintended times.
 Fixed numerous typos during the Partner Game Jam events.
 Fixed some slight inaccuracies in how certain stat bars show their progress.

We’ve also been made aware of crashing issues by some players. While we haven’t found a consistent, reliable way to replicate the crash, we have found that the game often uses more RAM than expected, which may be connected. We’re aiming to fix this in the next update, though it will take some significant code changes, so we appreciate your patience while we work hard on the issue!

Thanks for being a part of the Game Dev Club!

- Lyko Studio
